_description: Accepted pnpm production advisories. Add an entry only after a current audit identifies a vulnerability that is reviewed, unreachable or otherwise accepted, with a bounded re-review date.

allowlist.justification: No patched release exists (latest 1.1.3 is affected). Backend path is @tensorflow/tfjs-node > @tensorflow/tfjs > argparse@1 > sprintf-js@1.0.3; argparse is only used by the tfjs-custom-module CLI bin, which the backend never executes, so untrusted format strings cannot reach sprintf-js. Remove once a fixed sprintf-js ships or tfjs drops argparse.

_entrySchema.reviewDate: ISO date when the vulnerability was last reviewed (YYYY-MM-DD)
_entrySchema.nextReviewDate: ISO date when the vulnerability should be re-evaluated (YYYY-MM-DD)
